title: In this town, your hands glow whenever somebody needs you
description:
In this town, your hands glow whenever somebody needs you. Mine never have, not that I've seen, and that suits me fine.

My wife's dad swung the old bridge on the river for forty-one years, and every boat needed him. Since they bolted it shut, his hands have been going dark, and something has started crossing it in the fog.

It's made up, a creepy blocky story built with code and Blender.
pin: Whose hands would be glowing right now because of you?
